title: [review] provisioning.py:564: EDHOC handshake failure i
description: If receive_message() or the EDHOC processing methods raise an exception (timeout, protocol error, etc.), the session created at line 561 remains in _sessions. There's no try/finally to clean up the session on failure. Sessions accumulate until they expire via _expire_sessions(), potentially exhausting max_sessions slots if many provisioning attempts fail in quick succession.
